author: CityVision TV
title: Kurakani: the podcast sharing stories of the Nepali diaspora
summary: Long-form conversations with members of the Nepali community in Australia. Listen now on Spotify.
body:
Kurakani means conversation, and that is exactly what this podcast is about: honest, unhurried conversations with people from across the Nepali diaspora.

Episodes are available on Spotify, so you can listen on the drive to work, at the gym or at home.

Want to be a guest?

Tell us your story: your background, what you would like to talk about and your connection to the Nepali diaspora. Send us a Kurakani enquiry.
